name: skill-loader
description: Lazy-loads dev-suite skill bodies on demand. Enables target projects to install a lightweight skill index rather than copying all SKILL.md files eagerly, reducing disk footprint and Claude Code startup scan cost. Skills are fetched at runtime from the dev-suite source repository.

envVars.name: DEV_SUITE_ROOT
envVars.description: Absolute path to the dev-suite source repository. Required so the server can read skill files at runtime.
